A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''mother''' of the [[Myleena Dystra]]. She and her [[Myleena Dystra's father|husband]] were wealthy [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] who were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
